name: hooks
description: Inbound webhooks from the public internet through Tailscale Funnel: one route at a time, each checked by the sender's signature, stored and announced to watchers.

tips.text: Webhooks stay off until `vyre hooks on`. vyred then listens on loopback only, at `127.0.0.1:7310`.
Open one route at a time: `vyre hooks open northwind-orders --scheme stripe --secret northwind-orders-hook`.
`--scheme github` and `--scheme stripe` read the provider's own signature header. `hmac-sha256` uses the header you name.
`vyre hooks status` gives the public address to hand the sender, and flags anything Funnel publishes that does not line up.
Publish a route with Funnel on port 8443, never 443: vyred binds 443 on the tailnet addresses itself.
`vyre hooks close <name>` answers 404 at once, but Funnel keeps forwarding until you run the `tailscale funnel` line it prints.
Dry-run a watcher on a real delivery: take its id from `vyre hooks`, then pass it to `watchers.test`.
A service that reports only by webhook, like a payment processor or form service, can reach a watcher on your box through `vyre hooks`.
Run `vyre hooks` to see each open route, its scheme and secret, and its three latest deliveries.
A body seen before on the same route gets a 200 and is not announced again, so a sender's retries never double up.
